ofac_sdn.name: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List
ofac_sdn.access: free bulk via Sanctions List Service API (POST returns file list; downloads at /api/PublicationPreview/exports/{fileName}, 302 to presigned S3)
ofac_sdn.coverage: current snapshot as of 2026-08-07 publish; 19,199 entries
ofac_sdn.granularity: entity-level (name, type, programs, AKAs, addresses, IDs, nationality, citizenship, DOB, POB)
ofac_sdn.historical: snapshot is point-in-time; per-entry start dates not included. Delta change archive available via /api/PublicationPreview/GetDeltaFileArchive
ofac_sdn.role: firm-node sanction state: match firm/facility names to sanction status
ofac_sdn.citation: U.S. Treasury OFAC, Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List

ofac_consolidated.name: OFAC Consolidated (Non-SDN) Sanctions List
ofac_consolidated.coverage: current snapshot as of 2026-08-07 publish; 481 primary records
ofac_consolidated.granularity: entity-level (non-SDN lists: NS-PLC, SSI, FSE, CAPTA, MBS, NSCMIC etc.)
ofac_consolidated.citation: U.S. Treasury OFAC, Consolidated Sanctions List

gsdb.name: Global Sanctions Data Base (GSDB)
gsdb.access: REQUEST REQUIRED - data distributed via email request form (mailchimp: globalsanctionsdatabase.us2.list-manage.com/subscribe/post?u=ca659499444cdde6885f22d5d&id=3898dea0ef). No public direct download or mirror found (2026-08-09). Submit form -> data emailed; then drop files in data/gsdb/ and note release (R4 covers 1950-2023, 1,547 cases, case-specific + dyadic versions)
gsdb.granularity: sanction episodes (type, sender/target, objective, success, start/end dates); case-specific + dyadic versions
gsdb.citation: Felbermayr, Kirilakha, Syropoulos, Yalcin, Yotov (2020) 'The Global Sanctions Data Base', European Economic Review 129

scripts.download_ofac.py: resolves current file URLs from SLS API, downloads 4 files to cache/, writes cache/manifest.json. Rerunnable, --force to re-download.
scripts.normalize_ofac.py: parses SDN.XML -> data/ofac_sdn.csv (19,199 entities, lists pipe-joined); copies CONS_PRIM.CSV -> data/ofac_consolidated.csv (481 records). Self-checks count vs Record_Count.
